violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. UPON ARRIVAL TO CONDUCT THE INSPECTION, A CFM WAS NOT PRESENT TO MONITOR ACTIVE FOOD PREPARATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. DURING THE INSPECTION, A CFM ARRIVED AT THE FACILITY. ENSURE A CFM IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS WHICH FOOD PREPARATION IS OCCURRING.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS IN A CONTAINER STORED ON TOP OF READY-TO-EAT FOOD IN THE TOP OF THE PREP COOLER BY THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. KITCHEN STAFF MEMBER MOVED THE RAW SHELL EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF OF THE PREP COOLER.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: OBSERVED UNCOVERED FOOD IN THE WALK IN COOLER STORED UNDER DRIPPING CONDENSATE FROM THE CEILING
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. STAFF MEMBER REMOVED EXPOSED FOOD FROM UNDER THE DRIPPING CONDENSATION. FOOD PRODUCT STORED IN THE WALK IN COOLER MUST BE COVERED UNLESS IT IS ACTIVELY COOLING. GOM TANG E (Inspection Date: 10/13/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED BUILD UP OF POSSIBLE MOLD ON THE SHIELD INSIDE THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. ICE MACHINE MUST BE CLEANED PER THE MANUFACTURER’S INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BEAN SPROUTS IN ICE BATH ON KITCHEN PREP TABLE, COOKED CARTILAGE AND COOKED BEEF IN SINGLE DOOR PREP COOLER, FISH CAKE AND KIMCHI IN HALLWAY PREP COOLER NOT COLD HELD AT 41F OR BELOW. BEAN SPROUTS, 50F, CARTILAGE, 50F, BEEF, 50F, FISH CAKE, 61F, AND KIMCHI, 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. KIMCHI, FISH CAKE, AND COOKED BEEF WERE DISCARDED. CARTILAGE WAS MOVED TO THE WALK IN FREEZER. BEAN SPROUTS WERE MOVED TO THE WALK IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: UNPASTEURIZED, RAW SHELL EGGS SERVED UNDERCOOKED ARE NOT IDENTIFIED ON THE MENU WITH A CONSUMER ADVISORY. MENU ITEM: SUNDUBU JJIGAU
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS REQUESTED CFM CREATE A TABLE TENT DURING THE INSPECTION WITH THE DISCLOSURE AND REMINDER FOR THIS ITEM.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the bleach sanitizer solution was measured above 200ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. OBSERVED SANITIZER BUCKET WITH A CHLORINE BLEACH CONCENTRATION ABOVE 200PPM
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of chlorine bleach solution at 50-100ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM DISCARDED THE SANITIZER SOLUTION. A NEW SANITIZER BUCKET WAS MIXED TO THEH PROPER CONCENTRATION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED KIMCHI COOLING IN CLOSED, PLASTIC CONTAINER MORE THAN 2 INCHES DEEP. OBSERVED COOKED CARTILAGE COOLING IN STACK CONTAINERS IN THE PREP COOLER TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS AND CFM DISCUSSED PROPER COOLING METHODS. PORTION FOOD INTO SMALLER, SHALLOW, METAL CONTAINERS. COOL FOODS IN THE WALK IN COOLER OR FREEZER TO FACILITATE RAPID COOLING.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED LIVE COCKROACH ON TABLEWARE STORAGE SHELF AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. REQUEST ADDITIONAL PEST CONTROL SERVICE FROM A LICENSED PEST CONTROL COMPANY. CLEAN BUILD UP OF FOOD DEBRIS ON THE FLOORS, WALLS, TABLES, EQUIPMENT, AND UTENSILS. CORRECT THE VIOLATION WITHIN 10 DAYS. A FOLLOW UP WILL BE CONDUCTED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the tiled floor is not maintained in good repair. OBSERVED MULTIPLE BROKEN FLOOR TILES IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPAIR BROKEN FLOOR TILES BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED CONTAINER OF COOKED TOFU STORED IN MULTIPLE LAYERS COOLING IN 2 DR PREP UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM METHODS TO FACILITATE FASTER COOLING OF COOKED/PREPARED FOODS IN UNITS. EHS RECOMMENDED EITHER COOLING IN SHALLOW PAN AND/OR PLACING CONTAINER IN FREEZER TO ASSIST WITH COOLING PROCESS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: OBSERVED PORK THAWING IN PREP SINK FULL OF WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED CFM TO TURN ON COLD WATER TAP AND THAW UNDER RUNNING WATER. EHS EDUCATED CFM ON PROPER THAWING METHODS FOR FROZEN PROTEINS. GOM TANG E (Inspection Date: 04/16/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC. Observed WIC at 55F. EHS and CFM observed employees continually entering and exiting unit for preparation of foods.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS will follow up to verify unit is able to maintain cold holding temperature of 41F or below. CFM will monitor TCS food temperatures and instruct employees to open/close the unit strategically to maintain 41F or below. CFM will call for immediate service.
